name: The housing society's overhead tank
subject: physics
brief: The Nabapara Cooperative Housing overhead tank holds 4,000 litres when the pump stops at seven. The flats draw about 150 litres a minute, yet the caretaker finds it empty well before that rate predicts. Your group has one flow meter, shared with the next group. How long until the tank is empty?

quantities.name: Minutes until the tank is empty
Litres in the tank when the pump stops
Litres drawn by the flats a minute
Number of floors in the building

note: The hidden flow is a worn float valve leaking to the drain; only looking for a flow finds it. The Cooperative Housing is from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md (loc_family_flats).
